None of the suppliers meet all the specified criteria.

- **Holby Supply**: Price 170 (>60), Delivery 1 day (≤5), Rating 7 (≥6). Fails price.
- **Brenley Works**: Price 115 (>60), Delivery 13 days (>5), Rating 5 (<6). Fails all.
- **Fenstead Outfitters**: Price 50 (≤60), Delivery 1 day (≤5), Rating 7 (≥6). **Meets all criteria.**
- **Selhurst Traders**: Price 105 (>60), Delivery 3 days (≤5), Rating 4 (<6). Fails price and rating.

Fenstead Outfitters is the only supplier that quotes at most 60 per unit, delivers within 5 days, and is rated at least 6 out of 10.
